verdict.rationale: vLLM is a self-installable inference engine. The evidence covers local installation via pip/uv, offline inference, CPU and Apple Silicon support, and an air-gapped mode for its served docs, so local inference is clearly delivered. However, nothing in the pack explicitly states that prompts and data never leave the device. missing for 10: explicit documentation of no telemetry or outbound data transmission, a fully offline model-loading workflow (models are sourced from the Hugging Face Hub), and independent hands-on corroboration of fully local, air-gapped operation.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run inference entirely on my own machine so my data and prompts never leave my device

citations.quote: Install vLLM with uv (recommended) or pip:
Support for NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and x86/ARM/PowerPC CPUs.
simply set `trust_remote_code=True` for offline-inference or `--trust-remote-code` for the online serving.
To enable offline access in air-gapped environments, use the --enable-offline-docs flag
